purpose: Verify production integrity against the manifest-resolved current Graham week: exact verified slate, valid numeric or explicitly withheld fairs, recorded task attestation and a temporary next-week rollover dry-run. This does not certify completed football research, weekly learning or game readiness.

checks.requirement: Resolve the actual active season/week and bind its complete unique slate to verified schedule facts. Validate every numeric fair, generated explanation, home-field term, personnel/matchup overlay, frozen pre-kickoff prediction and schedule metadata. Shared-venue fairs may remain explicitly null only under the existing H4 fail-closed shape. Never coerce null into a numeric fair.

Validate the four recorded research-task attestation entries against repository schedule and completion authority, retaining their capture time and limitation: stored attestation is not current scheduler state or proof of completed football coverage.

Create and resolve the next Graham week only inside a temporary sandbox, carry forward all 32 current team ratings, inherit repository schedule metadata into the simulated next-week board/research ledger, verify required file paths before simulated activation, and prove the live active-week manifest is unchanged afterward.

passRule: All three production-integrity checks must pass against the same repository revision; all protected live inputs remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Include baseline, historical-learning, propagation and current-availability limitations separately. PASS never overrides incomplete football readiness.
